tagline: A leading U.S.-based precious metals mining company
hero_kpi_rationale: The company holds 3.5 million ounces of silver, 2,272 ounces of gold, 14,028 tonnes of zinc, and 8,322 tonnes of lead in concentrates exposed to future price fluctuations. A 10% change in prices would result in an impact of $18.3 million, reflecting significant exposure to metal price volatility risk.

kpis.name: Metals in concentrates exposed to price fluctuations
kpis.explanation: Total quantity of metals contained in sold concentrates exposed to future price fluctuations.
kpis.description: As of December 31, 2025, metals contained in sold concentrates exposed to future price fluctuations included 3.5 million ounces of silver, 2,272 ounces of gold, 14,028 tonnes of zinc, and 8,322 tonnes of lead. A 10% change in prices would result in an approximate impact of $18.3 million on the total value of concentrates.
kpis.signal: Exposure to metal price volatility risk and effectiveness of hedging strategies

kpis.name: Impact of a 10% change in metal prices
kpis.explanation: Financial impact on the value of sold concentrates in the event of a 10% change in metal prices.
kpis.description: A 10% change in the price of each metal would result in an approximate $18.3 million change in the total value of sold concentrates, partially offset by gains or losses on futures contracts used for hedging.
kpis.signal: Magnitude of exposure to metal price volatility risk

kpis.name: Net losses on precious metals collar contracts
kpis.explanation: Realized and unrealized losses on collar contracts used to manage exposure to fluctuations in precious metal prices.
kpis.description: Since the first quarter of 2025, the company has used collar contracts to manage exposure to fluctuations in precious metal prices within interim concentrates and estimated future sales. For the year ended December 31, 2025, these collars recorded net losses of $51.5 million, of which $15.2 million were realized.
kpis.signal: Cost of price hedging strategies and effectiveness of risk management instruments

kpis.name: Premiums paid for silver put option contracts
kpis.explanation: Total premium paid for financially settled silver put options aimed at protecting future sales against market price declines.
kpis.description: In December 2025, the company entered into financially settled silver put option contracts to manage exposure of future silver sales to potential market price declines. The total premium paid for the put contracts was $25 million, and the company recorded an unrealized loss of $10.4 million on the options during the year ended December 31, 2025.
kpis.signal: Cost of protection against silver price declines

kpis.name: Net foreign exchange loss USD/CAD
kpis.explanation: Net foreign exchange loss related to USD/CAD exchange rate fluctuations for Canadian operations.
kpis.description: For the year ended December 31, 2025, the company recorded a net foreign exchange loss of $5.7 million. A 10% change in the USD/CAD exchange rate would have resulted in an approximate $12.7 million change in net foreign exchange gains or losses.
kpis.signal: Exposure to foreign exchange risk from Canadian operations

kpis.name: Potential impact of a 10% USD/CAD change
kpis.explanation: Potential financial impact on foreign exchange gains or losses following a 10% change in the USD/CAD exchange rate.
kpis.description: A 10% change in the exchange rate between USD and CAD would have resulted in an approximate $12.7 million change in the company's net foreign exchange gains or losses.
kpis.signal: Magnitude of CAD foreign exchange risk exposure

risks.title: Metal price volatility
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly states that a substantial decline in metal prices would have a material adverse effect. The company holds 3.5 million ounces of silver, 2,272 ounces of gold, 14,028 tonnes of zinc, and 8,322 tonnes of lead exposed to future fluctuations, with a potential impact of $18.3 million for a 10% change. The company uses derivative instruments to mitigate this risk, but these instruments recorded a net loss of $51.5 million in 2025 on collars and $12.0 million across all contracts.

risks.title: USD/CAD foreign exchange risk
risks.score_rationale: The document details exposure to USD/CAD fluctuations for Canadian operations, reporting a net loss of $5.7 million in 2025 and a potential impact of $12.7 million for a 10% change. Hedging instruments are used (216 forward contracts for CAD 140.8 million) but expose the company to counterparty credit and exchange rate risks.

risks.title: Counterparty credit risk
risks.score_rationale: This risk is explicitly mentioned for derivative instruments used in managing metal and currency prices. It is noted that this risk arises in the event of counterparty non-performance when the contract price exceeds the spot price of a commodity. With over 200 outstanding forward contracts and collars covering more than 2 million ounces of silver, counterparty credit risk is significant.

risks.title: Derivative instruments risk
risks.score_rationale: The text describes extensive use of derivative instruments (futures, collars, put options) to manage price and foreign exchange risks. These instruments recorded a net loss of $51.5 million in 2025 on precious metals collars alone (of which $15.2 million realized), and a total loss of $12.0 million on metal price management contracts.

risks.title: Interest rate risk
risks.score_rationale: The document mentions a variable-rate credit facility. Although no amount was drawn as of December 31, 2025, a 1% increase in interest rates would result in an additional annual cost of $2.2 million. The language is factual and the risk is quantified.

ai_positioning.summary: HL does not mention artificial intelligence (AI) or machine learning in its 10-K filing. There is no indication of AI use in its operations or development of AI-related products.
